run_audio_magnet_16khz_explorer: run the MAGNET 16kHz audio grid explorer to launch SLURM training jobs for small and medium models
configure_slurm_partitions: configure SLURM partitions using AudioCraftEnvironment get_slurm_partitions with team and global partition types
bind_magnet_solver: bind the magnet audio_magnet_16khz solver and internal sounds dataset to the Dora launcher
launch_small_model_training: launch a 300M parameter MAGNET model training job on 32 GPUs using the explorer job array
launch_medium_model_training: launch a 1.5B parameter MAGNET model training job on 64 GPUs with FSDP enabled via the explorer
